headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. In other action, the Chicago Cubs came from behind to defeat the Baltimore Orioles 9-7, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the charge at the plate. Crow-Armstrong's impressive performance included two home runs and two RBIs.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Cleveland Guardians left-handed pitcher Tim Herrin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow contusion. The Boston Red Sox have also placed left-handed pitcher Ranger Suarez on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to a left groin strain. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Minnesota Twins, San Diego Padres, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Philadelphia Phillies.

The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers for cash consideration. The Detroit Tigers have also traded right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. Additionally, the Philadelphia Phillies have traded right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, while the Houston Astros have traded left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Homer Leads Tigers Past Athletics**
top_news.summary: Spencer Torkelson hit a 15th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored two runs, as the Detroit Tigers defeated the Athletics 6-1. Troy Melton earned the win with 5.1 innings pitched, striking out nine batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 3-0. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash consideration.
